Updates the mutable fields of a Payment. Only a Payment in `pending`
status can be changed; any other status returns `409 conflict`.

Amount, currency, beneficiary, and method are fixed once the Payment is
initiated: changing them would make it a different instruction. Submit a
new Payment instead.
